Method of Attack: Manually hacking into computers using Remote Desktop (RDP) to install ransomware
Terminating Explorer processes and preventing Task Manager launch to lock user out
Displaying a legal notice as ransom note before Windows login
Encrypting files with .crypted_file extension and creating individual ransom notes per file
Indicators of Compromise: Registry: HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon "LegalNoticeText" containing ransom note and victim ID
